answer: Locks are entered in prism, expire in zephyr, and yarrow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 33 aliases therefore needs 110 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1667 identities would post 1026 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
